## Coverage boundary

Mechanical extraction is exhaustive for native keys, modes, hashes, header/target lines, fixed-base/upstream identity and selected stack entries. The primary read selector/recipe mechanisms and grouped header/target evidence, plus the named prior context after initial observations. Vendor bodies were not read line by line. Current component releases, compilation, generated configuration and runtime behavior were not verified. Source application is bounded to the exact input and target projection in each receipt. No source ownership, removal, shipped-set or contribution decision changes.
